name: Platform Project List
description: Admin sees all projects with catalog-derived state filters and a create button. Client sees only assigned projects. Below 1024px cards retain complete names; larger screens keep project columns and detail access visible even with 175-character names, with or without spaces. Disponibilidad PA-263: conserva la estructura de proyectos y omite indicadores de módulos apagados; el equipo mantiene su acceso autorizado.
